annotations.title: Read how work is moving across every role

description: Every role in the workspace in one row each, changed or not: hours documented against its working month, hours a month saved, saved hours by stage (looking into, agreed, in place, confirmed, not placed yet), judgment work before and now, new work, and why a role wants attention (unproven savings, saved hours nobody is placing, no documented steps, no headcount). Plus totals. Use compass_role_story for one role's detail. Talk about roles, never about people.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
